description: Tiny Slim Framework 4 REST API (restapi/v1/index.php) exercising $app->get/post/put/delete route registrations with Slim's `:param` path-parameter syntax. Used by the extraction-quality benchmark to detect the #5733 regression where non-Laravel PHP frameworks synthesized zero http_endpoint_definition entities.

expected_relationships.note: #6490 arm B. `use Slim\Factory\AppFactory;` — the fully-qualified external class, kept fully qualified in the edge target.

`use Psr\Http\Message\ResponseInterface as Response;` and `…ServerRequestInterface as Request;`. Both collapse onto one lowercased package stub named `psr`, which loses ResponseInterface/ServerRequestInterface entirely — see the FINDING rows below. The edge itself is real and must not disappear.

#6490 arm B FINDING: the five endpoints are declared by this one file and NOTHING anchors them to it. Their only inbound edge is the repo-level `Module php-slim-mini CONTAINS …` produced by module aggregation, which is emitted for every entity in the graph and so distinguishes nothing.

#6490 arm B FINDING, and the reason this fixture can assert so little: `$app->get('/invoices', function (Request $request, Response $response) { … })` registers an ANONYMOUS handler, and the PHP extractor emits no Operation entity for a route closure. With no handler entity there can be no ROUTES_TO and no IMPLEMENTS, so all five endpoints are dead ends and the request-handling flow this fixture exists to model is absent from the graph. Compare java-spring-mini, where every endpoint carries an IMPLEMENTS edge back to its handler method.

#6490 arm B FINDING: PHP `use` of a namespaced class keeps its full path only for Slim\Factory\AppFactory (matched above); the two Psr imports are truncated to a lowercase vendor stub `psr` and deduplicated into one another, so the aliases `Response` and `Request` used throughout the route bodies bind to nothing.
